name: @bushizhanghan/dsh-routing-forensics
description: Forensic audit of past model-routing decisions: which turns put an expensive model on cheap work, which put a cheap model on expensive work and paid for it in retries, and which task shapes belong on which tier. Deterministic, no LLM — the money figures are estimates from a built-in price table, clearly labelled. 模型路由浪费取证：复盘每一次模型调用，算出钱花在了哪一档错误的模型上。
author: bushizhanghan
